name: Impact Solar LLC
old_description: “From Start to Finish, the Entire Process Was Professional, Transparent, and Remarkably Efficient.”
about:
Impact Solar LLC is based in Haddonfield, New Jersey. The company was founded by Rob Warren, who, after observing the practices of other solar providers, set out to offer a transparent, no-pressure approach to solar adoption. The firm has served the community for over 11 years, operating across more than a dozen New Jersey counties.

The company designs and installs custom solar photovoltaic systems for residential and commercial properties, including battery backup storage and electric-vehicle charging stations. It also provides ongoing service, maintenance, and repair for existing solar arrays — even those originally installed by other contractors — covering inverter diagnostics, production monitoring, wiring repairs, and electrical service upgrades. All installations use U.S.-made equipment.

Impact Solar works with homeowners and businesses throughout New Jersey, with specific project experience in towns such as Haddonfield, Moorestown, and across Atlantic, Bergen, Burlington, Camden, and other counties. Its customer base includes both new solar adopters and system owners seeking reliable long-term support.

Warren started the business to eliminate pushy sales tactics and provide honest guidance, clear upfront quotes, and a hands-on local team that remains involved long after installation. The company highlights its NABCEP-certified leadership and commitment to U.S.-made components as key differentiators.
